description: Capricorn decan 3 (January 10 to January 19): personality, love, work and growth, with Mercury as sub-ruler of the third ten degrees of Capricorn.
answer: In Western astrology, the third decan of Capricorn covers 20° to 29° of the sign, roughly January 10 to January 19, with Mercury as its sub-ruler beside Saturn. It is read as strategic intelligence with an analyst's eye for detail. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Capricorn decan 3 personality
paragraphs: The final ten degrees of Capricorn take Mercury as sub-ruler, the planet that governs Virgo. Saturn's sign therefore picks up a sharp, analytical and methodical edge. Natives are often described as strategic thinkers who plan several moves ahead and pay close attention to detail. They tend to enjoy problem-solving, organising information and finding efficient ways to get things done. Where the first decan emphasises endurance and the second appreciates quality, this one is often defined by its intelligence: practical, precise and occasionally sardonic. Conversations with them can be brisk and to the point, because they prefer to waste neither words nor time.

Mercury brings versatility and curiosity, which can make this decan more adaptable than the Capricorn stereotype suggests. They often have a talent for communication in professional contexts, writing clear reports or explaining complex systems simply. The flip side is a tendency to worry, overanalyse or become critical, both of others and of themselves. Perfectionism can slow them down. Traditionally this decan is linked with skill and craftsmanship, and many natives take pride in doing things properly. When they balance their high standards with patience, their mix of practical wisdom and mental agility makes them valued advisers, planners and quietly influential problem-solvers.

sections.heading: Capricorn decan 3 in love and at work
paragraphs: In love, Mercury's decan of Capricorn tends to value partners who are intelligent, reliable and good company in conversation. They often show care through problem-solving, offering practical help when something goes wrong. Romance may be understated, expressed through thoughtful planning rather than flowery words. They can be slow to open up emotionally, preferring to analyse feelings before sharing them. Partners who appreciate their wit and dependability usually find a loyal companion. Learning to express affection spontaneously, without first assessing whether it is warranted, can bring warmth and lightness to their relationships that matches their considerable reliability.

Professionally, this decan often excels in roles demanding precision and planning: analysis, accounting, operations, logistics, editing, engineering, quality control and consultancy. They tend to spot inefficiencies quickly and enjoy fixing them. Colleagues value their clarity and competence. They often make excellent organisers, the person who knows where everything is and why it matters. The risk is getting lost in details or becoming overly critical of colleagues who work differently. Recognising when good enough truly is good enough, and offering praise as readily as correction, helps them lead teams effectively and keeps their own stress manageable.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Capricorn decan 3: what Mercury adds
paragraphs: The third decan covers 20° to 29° of Capricorn, which in most years means birthdays from January 10 to January 19. Its sub-ruler, Mercury, comes from Virgo, the last earth sign after Capricorn, so this decan borrows a little of Virgo's character while staying Capricorn at heart. The other two decans of Capricorn belong to Saturn (decan 1) and Venus (decan 2). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Mercury lends curiosity, quick wits and a talent for language and detail. Under its influence a sign is said to think aloud, question more, trade information freely and enjoy problems that reward cleverness more than force. Mercurial decans are often linked with writing, trade, teaching and nimble problem-solving, and their usual lesson is to finish what the quick mind starts. Set against Capricorn's ambition, discipline, patience and dry, steady resilience, that Mercury note shifts the emphasis without changing the sign underneath.

sections.heading: Growth for Capricorn decan 3
paragraphs: The growth edge for third-decan Capricorn often lies in quieting the inner analyst. Worry can masquerade as preparation, so it helps to distinguish between planning that solves problems and rumination that only circles them. Setting a time limit on decisions can prevent endless refinement. Physical activity, crafts or time outdoors can rest a busy mind. It is also worth practising gentleness with mistakes, their own and others'. Their skill and intelligence are undeniable assets. When balanced with self-acceptance, they can enjoy the satisfaction of a job well done rather than dwelling on its small imperfections.

Within Capricorn, decan 1 leans towards discipline, patience and long-range ambition in their most classic form and decan 2 leans towards ambition polished with taste, sensuality and a builder's patience. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: What makes the third decan of Capricorn distinctive?
faq.answer: Mercury, ruler of Virgo, gives this decan an analytical and detail-oriented quality. Natives are often described as strategic planners and skilled communicators who value efficiency. Their challenge is usually perfectionism or worry, which tends to ease when they accept that good work need not be flawless.

faq.question: What are the dates of Capricorn decan 3?
faq.answer: In most years January 10 to January 19, the days when the Sun is between 20° and 29° of Capricorn. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Capricorn decan 3?
faq.answer: Mercury. In the triplicity system each earth sign's decans take the rulers of the earth signs in order, starting with Capricorn's own ruler, Saturn.
